name: Iron Ascent
look: a white robot Rayquaza coiled into a great ring, traced with glowing cyan circuits, with floating panes of cyan glass, a white helmet head with a cyan orb eye and two long navy blades
entry: A Pokémon resembling Rayquaza, recorded in a report about a satellite that coiled itself into a ring above the world's edge. Its glass fins drink starlight to power its endless flight.
how: Wild: very rare on the End's outer islands.
